changes.before: For quasi-projective complex varieties and finitely many algebraic operations/support collections, the geometric suppliers give individually chosen compatible smooth Whitney strata, conical local products and finite deleted-boundary triangulation models for each operation. No simultaneous stratification of an arbitrary cyclic diagram respecting all marked supports is asserted. On any separated finite-type complex variety, bounded algebraically constructible objects have bounded finite ordinary and compact-support cohomology, ordinary derived Hom and bounded constructible internal Hom, with coefficient-extension compatibility, by these models locally and finite affine-open descent globally. A noncompact variety is not asserted to be a finite compact realization.
